english: What happened?
Can you tell me what happened?
Where does it hurt?
Where is the pain?
When did the symptoms start?
When did this start?
phrases.notes: START was not in the Anysign A-Z list. Signer to confirm.

english: Can you describe the pain?
What does the pain feel like?
phrases.notes: Signer decides how to ask. Consider icon choices on the patient screen (sharp, dull, pressure).

english: How severe is your pain on a scale of 1 to 10?
How bad is the pain, 1 to 10?
phrases.notes: Pair with number buttons 1-10 on the patient screen so no reading is needed.

english: Do you have any existing medical conditions?
Do you have any health problems?
phrases.notes: Concept-heavy. Signer decides the natural phrasing.

english: Are you currently taking any medications?
Do you take any medicine?
phrases.notes: TAKE was not found as its own sign in the Anysign list.

english: Do you have any allergies?
Are you allergic to anything?
phrases.notes: ALLERGY was not in the Anysign list. Must be recorded by a signer.

english: Have you experienced this before?
Has this happened before?
Have you eaten or had anything to drink today?
Did you eat or drink today?
Are you having difficulty breathing?
Are you having trouble breathing?
phrases.notes: BREATHE was not in the Anysign list. Must be recorded by a signer.

english: Are you experiencing chest pain or pressure?
Do you have chest pain?
phrases.notes: CHEST and PAIN were not in the Anysign list. Must be recorded by a signer.

english: Did you lose consciousness or pass out?
Did you faint?
phrases.notes: Must be recorded by a signer.

english: Did you hit your head or neck?
Did you injure your head or neck?
phrases.notes: HEAD was in the Anysign list. HIT and NECK were not.

english: Can you move your arms and legs normally?
Can you move your arms and legs?
phrases.notes: Signer may demonstrate the movement. Must be recorded.
